title: Woodland Shores
meta_description: Woodland Shores sleeps 30 across 10 bedrooms, each with a private bath, plus an oversized pool, spa, game room, and guest golf cart.
description_expanded:
A ten-bedroom house is a logistics problem right up until it isn't. Woodland Shores is the version where it isn't. Roughly 5,000 square feet on a quiet, tree-lined stretch of Santa Rosa Beach, with room for 30 and a floor plan that keeps everyone comfortably spread out, this is the house that finally makes the reunion, the bachelorette weekend, or the milestone birthday trip actually happen instead of staying theoretical in the group chat.

The bedroom count is the headline, but the bathroom count is the real story. Five king suites, two additional king bedrooms, and three bunk rooms with full-over-full setups each come with a private bath, which means nobody is negotiating shower schedules or quietly resenting a roommate by day three. The rooms run big, too. Guests mention it, and it matters when people are settling in for a week rather than a night. The bunk rooms tend to get claimed fast by kids and by friend groups who'd rather all be in one room than scattered across the house. A game room on the first floor and a big living room upstairs give the group two places to land, so the late-night card tournament and the movie with the little ones can happen at the same time without anyone compromising. And when everyone comes back together, the dining table seats the whole crew at once. Past guests call out that first all-together dinner as the moment the trip actually starts.

Out back is where the house earns its keep. The pool is genuinely oversized, which changes the math on a group this size: everyone can swim, float, and lounge at once without feeling stacked on top of each other. A spa alongside gives the adults somewhere quieter to settle in once the kids are down. The patio runs long and lined with loungers for rotating between sun and shade, and the firepit, outdoor dining setup, and built-in grill turn most evenings into a cookout that goes well past sunset. In-home laundry and real parking keep the logistics boring, which is the goal. A six-seater golf cart is available to guests for coffee runs and short hops.

Santa Rosa Beach anchors the middle of Scenic Highway 30A, one of the most walked, biked, and photographed stretches of the Florida Panhandle. Seaside, WaterColor, and Grayton Beach are all in easy reach, and the Timpoochee Trail links the whole corridor if the group wants to spend a morning on bikes. The area's coastal dune lakes are a genuine rarity, with only a handful like them on earth, and outfitters will deliver paddleboards straight to the water at Grayton Beach State Park. Point Washington State Forest sits just inland for anyone who wants pine flatwoods and quiet instead of sand and crowds. Evenings take care of themselves between the restaurants, the boutiques, and the live music.

Whether the group is here to do everything or deliberately nothing, Woodland Shores has the room and the setup to let the week become whatever it wants to be.

AvantStay provides an upscale experience with services that elevate your stay and save time so you can enjoy every moment. Guests have access to a 24/7 support team and a tech-enabled concierge to book services, such as fridge stocking, mid-stay cleanings, and private chefs. For anything you need (or never knew you needed), we're at your service!

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach.

Home Truths:
- This home allows up to 2 pets for a fee; undisclosed pets brought without AvantStay's approval may result in a $500 fine per pet.
- A single 6-seater golf cart is available for guest use upon receipt of a signed liability waiver.
- Pool heating is available upon request for $150/day.
- Pack 'n play is available upon request

Parking Details:
- Free driveway parking for 5 cars max

Pack-n-Play and high chair are available upon request.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.
